+def _get_locale_pak_path(locales_dir: str, locale: str) -> str:
+    """Get the path of the QtWebEngine resource file for a locale."""
+    return os.path.join(locales_dir, locale + '.pak')
+
+
+def _get_lang_override(versions: version.WebEngineVersions,
+                       locale: str) -> Optional[str]:
+    """Choose an installed locale for the QtWebEngine 5.15.3 Linux workaround.
+
+    Return None if the workaround is inapplicable or the requested locale's
+    resource file already exists.
+    """
+    if (not config.val.qt.workarounds.locale or not utils.is_linux or
+            versions.webengine != utils.VersionNumber(5, 15, 3)):
+        return None
+
+    locales_dir = os.path.join(
+        QLibraryInfo.location(QLibraryInfo.TranslationsPath),
+        'qtwebengine_locales')
+    locale = locale.replace('_', '-')
+    if os.path.isfile(_get_locale_pak_path(locales_dir, locale)):
+        return None
+
+    language = locale.split('-', maxsplit=1)[0]
+    if language == 'en':
+        fallback = 'en-US' if locale in ('en', 'en-US', 'en-LR', 'en-PH') else 'en-GB'
+    elif language == 'es':
+        fallback = 'es' if locale == 'es-ES' else 'es-419'
+    elif language == 'pt':
+        fallback = 'pt-BR' if locale == 'pt' else 'pt-PT'
+    elif language == 'zh':
+        fallback = 'zh-TW' if locale in ('zh-HK', 'zh-MO', 'zh-TW') else 'zh-CN'
+    else:
+        fallback = language
+
+    for candidate in (fallback, language, 'en-US'):
+        if os.path.isfile(_get_locale_pak_path(locales_dir, candidate)):
+            return candidate
+
+    # Even when the locale directory cannot be found, Chromium's default is
+    # en-US; this is the safest value to pass as its language override.
+    return 'en-US'
+
